## How we make decisions

1. Open an **RFC** in your team's folder when a change affects more than one team or is hard to reverse.
2. Collect feedback in the merge request until the `reviewBy` date.
3. Record the outcome as an **ADR** and link the RFC under `related`.

> [!TIP]
> Not sure if you need an ADR? If someone will ask "why did we do this?" in a year, write one.
